_what: The shop's real-world facts: where it is, when it is open, how to reach it. This is the ONE place these live. Anything that needs an address, a phone number or opening hours reads it from here.
_whyNotBrandJson: brand/brand.json is a transcription of brand/guidelines/LS_Brand-Guidelines_v01.pdf and nothing else — that contract is written in CLAUDE.md and in brand/README.md. None of the facts below appear in that PDF or in the Complete Brand Identity Kit; all 20 pages and all 3 pages were read on 2026-08-26 to confirm it. Putting them in brand.json would quietly break the rule that brand.json says what the PDF says. So they live here instead, beside it.

name: La Sabrosita Ice Cream & Snacks

address._settled: 1422 Kings Hwy is CORRECT and SETTLED. The client confirmed it on 2026-08-26 and asked that it not be questioned again: the Google Business Profile is the source of truth for this address. A neighbouring storefront sign reads 1420 Kings Hwy (King's Things, the furniture store next door) — that is the adjacent unit, not a discrepancy. Do not raise it again.

hours._format: 24-hour, opens/closes, local time. Days the shop is closed would carry closed: true.
hours._confirm: CONFIRMED BY THE CLIENT on 2026-08-26. Friday's 11:00-18:00 and Saturday's 19:00-22:00 are correct as written — they looked unusual for an ice cream shop and were queried; Luis confirmed them. Do not 'fix' them.

googleBusinessProfile._note: Recorded as a fact about the profile on 2026-08-26. NOT for printing on the site as a rating badge unless Luis asks — a star count that drifts out of date on a real shop's own website is worse than none, and the individual review text is not ours to reproduce.

presence._websiteNote: The Google panel offers 'Add website', so no site is linked yet. Once this one is live, adding it to the profile is worth doing — it is the single highest-value SEO action available here.

unconfirmed._what: Seen on third-party listings, NOT given by the client. Do not publish any of these until confirmed. Cash-only was one of these and turned out to be false.
unconfirmed.cashOnly: FALSE — corrected by the client on 2026-08-26. Yelp's listing says '** CASH ONLY **' and it is WRONG. The shop takes cards. Never publish the Yelp claim, and if anyone re-scrapes third-party listings later, this line is why it must not come back.
unconfirmed.parking: Yelp says the shop has parking options.
unconfirmed._yelpIsWrong: Yelp is telling customers the shop is cash only when it is not. That is a listing costing the shop walk-ins, and it is fixable from Yelp's own 'suggest an edit' flow. Worth doing — it is not a website change.

payments._note: Recorded as a fact. NOT printed on the site — 'we take cards' is a strange thing for a shop to have to announce, and saying it invites the question. It is here so the repo knows the Yelp claim is false.

amenities._note: Published on the site. It answers "can we stay?", which is a real reason to choose this shop over a counter you eat outside of, and neither reference site can say it — they are packaged brands in a freezer aisle.
